metric_definitions.baseline_accuracy: baseline correct / digit-labeled samples, before any rejection
metric_definitions.accepted_coverage: accepted / all samples in this group
metric_definitions.accepted_accuracy: accepted correct / accepted digit-labeled samples; null if none accepted
metric_definitions.correct_over_all_samples: accepted correct / all digit-labeled samples; rejections never correct
metric_definitions.reject_valid_rate: rejected / digit-labeled samples (synthetic labels are only intended strokes)
metric_definitions.null_rates: A zero denominator is JSON null, never NaN or perfect accuracy
